listings.name: RA Motors and Panelbeaters
listings.current_description: RA Motors and Panelbeaters is a SAMBRA-accredited motor mechanical and panelbeating workshop in Ladanna, Polokwane, established in 2004, offering everything from routine services and engine, gearbox and brake rebuilds to full electrical diagnostics and factory-standard body repairs in its own spray booth.

listings.name: Roman's Pizza Platinum Park
listings.current_description: Roman's Pizza Platinum Park is a branch of the Roman's Pizza takeaway franchise in Platinum Park, Bendor Park, serving pizza in a choice of pan or traditional crust, plus pasta, pizza pies, garlic bread and salads, with dough prepared fresh in-store daily.

listings.name: STAFIX Electric Fence & Security
listings.current_description: STAFIX Electric Fence & Security is the Southern African distributor of STAFIX and JVA electric fence energisers, based in Nirvana and supplying imported and locally-manufactured fencing and security products for agricultural, wildlife and perimeter-security markets, backed by a network of accredited installers.

listings.name: Stay on Plein
listings.current_description: Stay on Plein is a self-catering guesthouse in Hospital Park offering individually themed rooms with private entrances and en-suite bathrooms, solar power that keeps it running through load-shedding, and guest amenities such as Wi-Fi, smart TVs, a swimming pool and braai facilities.

listings.name: Steendal Guest House
listings.current_description: Steendal Guest House is a garden guesthouse on Bendor Drive in Sterpark offering five individually decorated en-suite suites with private garden access, a swimming pool and braai area, and cooked breakfast; it is pet-friendly and about 4km from Mall of the North.

listings.name: The Guesthouse 8 on Impala
listings.current_description: The Guesthouse 8 on Impala is an 11-room guesthouse in Fauna Park, about 550m from Savannah Mall, with en-suite bathrooms, air-conditioning and tea/coffee facilities in every room, plus a communal lounge and bar, a swimming pool, free Wi-Fi and off-street parking.

listings.name: Cashbuild Polokwane Central
listings.current_description: Cashbuild Polokwane Central is a branch of the national hardware and building materials retailer on the corner of Boom and Excelsior Street, stocking cement, roofing and aluminium doors and windows, and offering services such as free plan reading and costing and glass cutting.

listings.name: Computers R Us
listings.current_description: Computers R Us has stocked a wide range of computers, laptops and computer consumables from its Polokwane Lifestyle Centre premises since 2007, having first opened in Polokwane back in 2002; its technicians also install and maintain networks and servers for businesses across Limpopo.

listings.name: Country Blue Luxury Accommodation
listings.current_description: Country Blue Luxury Accommodation is a guest house in Hospital Park with 50 rooms across two storeys, each with air-conditioning, a kitchenette and free Wi-Fi, plus an on-site restaurant, bar, outdoor swimming pool and garden, and conference facilities for up to 70 delegates.

listings.name: DLB Signs
listings.current_description: DLB Signs is a signage manufacturer in Superbia, Polokwane with a decade in the industry, producing vehicle graphics and wrapping, safety and road signs, digital printing, window branding and banners, plus custom vinyl stickers, steel cut-out letters and light boxes for local businesses.

listings.name: Glass King Aluminium
listings.current_description: Glass King Aluminium is a glass and aluminium specialist in Superbia, Polokwane with over 40 years of combined experience, manufacturing and installing custom aluminium windows, sliding and folding doors, and frameless glass shower enclosures, plus sandblasting, glass repairs, splashbacks, mirrors and picture framing.

listings.name: Incredible Connection
listings.current_description: Incredible Connection is a South African technology retail chain, founded in 1995 and headquartered in Sandton, selling laptops, desktop computers, printers, cellphones, tablets and gaming consoles; this Mall of the North branch also has an in-store Technical Centre for installations, upgrades and repairs.

listings.name: Kingsley Heath
listings.current_description: Kingsley Heath is a South African luxury fashion brand established in 1994, offering men's and women's clothing, leather goods and footwear inspired by Africa's natural heritage; this Mall of the North store is one of its boutiques across South Africa, Namibia and London.

listings.name: Lekoana Driving Institute
listings.current_description: Lekoana Driving Institute is a driving school near the University of Limpopo's Turfloop campus in Mankweng, offering lessons on both manual and automatic vehicles and preparing learners for their Learner's Licence with lessons on road signs, rules of the road and mock tests.

listings.name: Meropa Casino & Entertainment World
listings.current_description: Meropa Casino & Entertainment World is a casino and entertainment complex in Ivy Park with more than 400 slot machines and 17 gaming tables, plus the Jembe Tavern for live music, comedy and cabaret nights and family attractions such as mini-golf and go-karting.

listings.name: Milady's
listings.current_description: Miladys is a South African women's fashion retailer founded in 1947 in Pinetown, KwaZulu-Natal, and part of the Mr Price Group since 1987; it stocks clothing, footwear and accessories in sizes 32 to 50. This branch trades from Savannah Mall in Fauna Park.

listings.name: Plein On Suid Guesthouse
listings.current_description: Plein On Suid Guesthouse is a recently renovated guesthouse in Hospital Park, Polokwane, offering family rooms with private bathrooms, kitchenettes and TVs. The property is set around an outdoor swimming pool, garden and braai facilities, with free WiFi, on-site parking and full-day security.

listings.name: Theo Goosen Estate Agents & Auctioneers
listings.current_description: Theo Goosen Estate Agents & Auctioneers has served the Limpopo property market from Polokwane since 1960, handling residential, commercial, industrial and farm property sales as well as property auctions. The firm relocated to its current General Maritz Street, Bendor office in early 2025.

listings.name: Totalsports
listings.current_description: Totalsports at Mall of the North is a branch of the sporting goods retailer founded in 1982, now part of The Foschini Group and the largest sports retail chain in Southern Africa, stocking footwear and apparel from brands including Nike, adidas and Puma.

listings.name: Bona Manzi Water Drilling
listings.current_description: Bona Manzi Water Drilling is a borehole drilling company based in Ladanna serving Polokwane and the wider region, offering services from drilling through to pump installation and water tank/stand erection, using geophysical and hydrological methods rather than geological survey equipment to locate water.

listings.name: CV World
listings.current_description: CV World is a CV joint specialist in Futura that has manufactured and supplied CV joints since 1991, backed by a one-year guarantee on joints fitted in-house, and also handles gearbox, diff, propshaft, clutch and brake work along with general vehicle servicing and diagnostics.

listings.name: Gemstone Bed and Breakfast
listings.current_description: Gemstone Bed and Breakfast is a guesthouse and day spa in Mankweng Zone 1, offering en-suite rooms individually themed around different gemstones with double beds, DStv television, and tea/coffee facilities, alongside an on-site day spa for guests wanting spa treatments during their stay.

listings.name: Miladys
listings.current_description: Miladys is a South African women's fashion retailer founded in 1947 in Pinetown, KwaZulu-Natal, and part of the Mr Price Group since 1987; it stocks clothing, footwear and accessories in sizes 32 to 50. This branch trades from Mall of the North in Bendor.

listings.name: The Village Inn
listings.current_description: The Village Inn is a guesthouse on a quiet smallholding in the bush in Dalmada, on the Tzaneen road outside Polokwane, offering family rooms with private bathrooms and air-conditioning, a swimming pool, and a restaurant serving South African cuisine with halal and vegetarian options.

listings.name: Car Service City - Polokwane
listings.current_description: Car Service City Polokwane is a car servicing and repair workshop in Superbia that has operated since 2015, specialising in vehicles out of motor plan (3 years and older) across all makes, bakkies and 4x4s, and offering a free 62-point check with every major service.

listings.name: Debbie Mouton Jewellers
listings.current_description: Debbie Mouton Jewellers is an independent Polokwane jewellery retailer, part of the Gold City Jewellers group, offering custom-made and hand-picked jewellery, premium watch brands such as TAG Heuer and Tissot, valuations and jewellery repairs at its Mall of the North store, which opened in 2011.

listings.name: Jabez Christian Academy
listings.current_description: Jabez Christian Academy is a combined Christian school in Eduan Park teaching the National Curriculum from Grade R through matric, pairing academic instruction with daily Bible time, sport, and cultural activities such as drama, chess and choir across its pre-school, primary and high school phases.

listings.name: Legit
listings.current_description: Legit is a South African women's fashion and accessories retailer aimed at the middle-to-lower income market, operating in over 460 stores across South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho and eSwatini under the Retailability group; this Mall of the North store is one of its Polokwane branches.

listings.name: Levi's
listings.current_description: Levi's is a global denim and jeans brand founded in 1873; the company re-entered the South African market in 1994 following the country's first democratic elections and now has offices in Cape Town, Johannesburg and Durban, with some ranges manufactured locally at its Epping facility.

listings.name: Mighty Scrapyard cc
listings.current_description: Mighty Scrapyard has been trading in Ladanna since 2001, stripping and selling new and second-hand vehicle spares -- especially engines, gearboxes and diffs for VW, Toyota, Nissan and Ford -- and also offers vehicle towing and recovery; it is an RMI member and insurance-approved supplier.

listings.name: Virgin Active Polokwane
listings.current_description: Virgin Active Polokwane is a full-service health club at the Pietersburg Sports Node in Polokwane, offering cardio and strength training areas, a swimming pool, a steam room, and a supervised kids' facility for children aged 6 weeks to 7 years, alongside in-club personal training services.

listings.name: Cambridge Food Seshego Circle
listings.current_description: Cambridge Food Seshego Circle is a branch of the Cambridge Food supermarket chain, which began with six fresh-meat stores in KwaZulu-Natal in the 1990s and has since grown into a national chain selling fresh meat, groceries, and household and health and beauty products, at Seshego Circle.

listings.name: Markham
listings.current_description: Markham is a men's fashion retail chain selling jeans, smartwear, footwear and accessories, and is the largest standalone men's fashion chain in Southern Africa with over 325 stores; it operates as part of TFG (The Foschini Group). This branch trades from Savannah Mall in Fauna Park.

listings.name: Protea Driving School
listings.current_description: Protea Driving School is a K53 driving school on Schoeman Street in Polokwane Central, one of the longest-running driving schools in South Africa, offering computerised learner's licence training, Code 8 and 10 driving lessons, refresher training and test-day bookings, with a second branch in Witbank/eMalahleni.

listings.name: Scrap Metal Lady
listings.current_description: Scrap Metal Lady is a scrap-metal buying and collection business in Hospital Park, sourcing bulk metal (minimum around 12 tonnes per collection) from schools, mines, farms, demolition companies, scrap yards and automobile yards across South Africa, using its own trucks with no transport charge to sellers.

listings.name: The Macaw Nest
listings.current_description: The Macaw Nest is a guest house and family restaurant on a plot in Dalmada, combining six guestrooms and a tea garden with a bird conservation and breeding aviary, plus a restaurant serving grilled steaks, chicken and vegetarian dishes, and venue hire for conferences and events.

listings.name: 61 on Ireland Guest House
listings.current_description: 61 on Ireland is a 4-star guest house in Moregloed with five air-conditioned suites, each featuring a flat-screen TV and private bathroom, set around a garden with an outdoor pool and bar; guests also have free WiFi, a laundry service, and shuttle transport available by prior arrangement.

listings.name: Modhope Properties
listings.current_description: Modhope Properties is a firm of registered property valuers based in Hospital Park, Polokwane, providing valuations of residential, commercial, industrial and retail properties (including shopping centres) as well as specialised properties such as schools, petrol stations, churches and creches, for sale, rental, rating, mortgage and insurance purposes.

listings.name: Precision Spares
listings.current_description: Precision Spares is a Futura-based supplier specialising in Cummins engine parts (including the 4BT, 6BT, 6CT, NT855, N14, ISM, L10, M11, ISX, QSX and KT1150 series), also carrying out engine overhauls and mechanical repairs, and acting as an agent for Fuller transmissions, Rockwell diffs and Fleetguard filtration.

listings.name: Taxila Secondary School
listings.current_description: Taxila Secondary School is a public high school in Nirvana, Polokwane, teaching Grade 8 to Grade 12 with specialised streams in Sciences, Commerce, Humanities and Technology, and is recognised as one of Limpopo's highest-performing public high schools, having posted a 95.6% matric pass rate in 2024.

listings.name: The Lofts Overnight Accommodation
listings.current_description: The Lofts Overnight Accommodation is a four-star graded guesthouse in Polokwane's CBD offering lofts, an economy unit, standard and twin rooms across 15 sleeping rooms, plus a conference facility for up to 22 people and a cash bar and restaurant, a few minutes from Peter Mokaba Stadium.

listings.name: Unjani Clinic Lebowakgomo
listings.current_description: Unjani Clinic Lebowakgomo is a nurse-led primary healthcare clinic, opposite Mall@Lebo, offering diagnosis and treatment of common ailments (including medication) and a well-baby clinic with immunisations. It is part of the wider Unjani Clinic network of clinics owned and run by professional nurses across South Africa.

listings.name: Mayfair Gearbox Polokwane
listings.current_description: Mayfair Gearbox Polokwane is a gearbox, clutch and differential repair specialist that has served Annadale for more than 15 years as part of a national franchise with branches across South Africa. It also handles minor vehicle servicing, with repair work backed by a 6-month or 10,000km guarantee.

listings.name: Seeff Polokwane
listings.current_description: Seeff Polokwane is a residential estate agency that has operated in Polokwane for more than 18 years, with sales and rental teams handling houses, apartments, cluster developments, security estates, land and guesthouses from its Platinum Park office, and is noted for marketing new residential developments in the city.

listings.name: Sonpra Lebowakgomo
listings.current_description: Sonpra Lebowakgomo is a branch of the Sonpra Superstore upholstery supplier, stocking fabrics, vinyls, genuine leather, tools and canvas for motor vehicle interiors, home decor and outdoor upholstery projects, at Lepelle Crossing Shopping Centre. It was one of two new Sonpra stores opened alongside a Polokwane warehouse outlet.

listings.name: Victoria Place Guest House
listings.current_description: Victoria Place Guest House is a Victorian-style guest house in Hospital Park with en-suite bedrooms and luxury suites, each offering a stocked bar fridge, DStv and free WiFi, plus laundry and dry-cleaning service and secure parking; it has been a finalist in the AA Accommodation Awards multiple times.

listings.name: Christ Church Cathedral
listings.current_description: Christ Church Cathedral is the seat of the Anglican Diocese of St Mark the Evangelist and the only Anglican church in Polokwane, with a congregation dating back over a century to the town's early days as Pietersburg; the present church on Biccard Street celebrated its Diamond Jubilee in 1957.

listings.name: Destiny Inn Lodge
listings.current_description: Destiny Inn Lodge is a private, eco-friendly resort in Dalmada offering executive and standard guest rooms and self-catering cottages, each with a private bathroom, set among gardens with an outdoor pool, a Lapa and boma for braais, and a restaurant with room service, alongside a conference facility for events.

listings.name: Lambrechts & Van Dyk Bk
listings.current_description: Lambrechts & Van Dyk Bk is a motor vehicle assessing and loss-adjusting firm in Dalmada, handling manual, Audatex and digital damage assessments for cars, LDVs, trucks, motorcycles, trailers, caravans and taxis, and belongs to the Institute of Motor Assessors of SA and the Institute of Loss Adjusters of SA.

listings.name: The Place Food Eatery
listings.current_description: The Place Food Eatery is a restaurant at Zone A Caravan Park in Lebowakgomo, serving an a la carte menu of seafood, meat, poultry and vegetarian dishes alongside daily specials, hot and cold platters, and desserts, and was established with support from a small-business empowerment programme for women entrepreneurs.
